description: Sitemaps known to Search Console for the property: path, lastSubmitted, lastDownloaded, isPending, errors, warnings and contents per type (web, image, video, news: submitted URL counts). Search Console no longer reports indexed counts per sitemap through the API, so `indexed` is usually 0 — use get_indexing_tracker for indexing. Use to confirm Google is fetching the sitemap, spot errors/warnings and count submitted URLs. / Sitemaps da propriedade com status de download, erros e URLs enviadas.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.
